cohort: 232 women with a single previous cesarean delivery and no prior vaginal delivery, delivering a singleton preterm newborn at two tertiary medical centers during 2010-2020
finding: TOLAC in preterm deliveries among women with no prior vaginal delivery is safe and has a high success rate, with preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM) being the only independent negative predictor of success.
mod_finding: The study found a 76.7% success rate for TOLAC in preterm deliveries among women with no prior vaginal delivery, with preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM) being the only negatively associated predictor.
